name: Bandzoogle

pricing.free_plan: 14-day trial without a credit card; the site is public on <name>.bandzoogle.com during the trial

capabilities: Built for bands: tour dates, mailing list, music player and merch built in
Mailing list and fan CRM included rather than bolted on
Templates aimed at musicians, not adapted from business themes
limits: The 14-day trial publishes on a bandzoogle.com address without a card — verified 09.11.2026 with a live site.
Trial only: nothing stays online without a paid plan
No AI prompt: you pick a template and fill it
Payment for merch depends on the tier

Content build was not completed in our automated run: the page editor needs a custom date picker, block panels and per-form saves that resisted scripted input. The trial page carries a bio and a contact form; tour dates and releases are incomplete. No score was issued.
summary: Musician-specific site builder with tour dates, mailing list and music built in.

payments.detail: Merch payments depend on the tier

custom_domain.detail: Custom domain is included in every website plan; there is no free plan, only a 14-day trial

run_blocker: No prompt step: Bandzoogle is a template-and-editor builder for musicians. The feature list (checked 13.11.2026) has no AI generation; a same-brief run would measure the operator, not the tool. It stays documented, with price and free-plan limits, and carries no score.

no_ai.reason: Template-and-editor builder for musicians, no AI generation. A same-brief run would measure the operator.
